records.name: La Placita Wellness and Education Center
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs health and fitness programs for kids and families, including the Fitadelphia and What's Eating You Kid? programs. It also lists summer camps, community festivals and fitness events.
records.what_you_do: Join a listed camp, festival or fitness event, or follow the programs online. The site gives no sign-up steps, so email first to ask what is running.

first_step.how: Email info@laplacitawellness.com to ask which camps, festivals or fitness events are running now
first_step.basis: The site lists public events and gives an email address to ask about them, but shows no dates and no sign-up steps.

records.notes: Dormant only because the one dated item on the site is a 2023 award title (year only, no month). Its event and program lists are undated. The IRS filing address is 7702 Hartel Ave, 19152, but the site shows no street address, so no location was published. Fitadelphia and What's Eating You Kid? are the group's own programs, not separate groups. Confirm current activity before going live.

records.name: Loverock Nonprofit Charitable Foundation
records.summary: A small charity that helps people in Philadelphia who are homeless or short of money. Volunteers walk the streets to hand out home cooked meals and food and hygiene gift bags, and the group also helps with clothing, shelter and medical needs.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers hand out meals and gift bags on the street. Call the group to ask how to help with outreach or how to get help yourself.

first_step.how: Call 215-730-5677 and ask how to volunteer on the street outreach
first_step.basis: The site invites visitors to call but describes no volunteer sign-up steps, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site is live but has no dated posts, events or news (its Blog menu shows no dated entries). The only date is the 2019 founding year, which is not evidence of current activity. The site gives only 'Philadelphia, PA' as a location. IRS filing address is 1129 Passmore St, 19111. Partner named on the site: Theresa Nonprofit Foundation of Diabetes Fund (donation link only, listed in leads_only).

records.name: Royal Sisters Project
records.summary: A Philadelphia mentoring program for girls ages 13 to 19 that aims to prevent violence. Girls join free eight-week cohorts with weekly Monday mentoring, plus leadership, life skills and creative workshops.
records.what_you_do: Each girl meets a mentor on Mondays and joins weekend workshops during an eight-week cohort. Registration is through the group's online form.

schedule.text: One-on-one mentoring every Monday during eight-week cohorts, plus weekend workshops

locations.label: Address listed on the group's GoFundMe page

first_step.how: Fill out the registration form on royalsistersproject.com for the next eight-week cohort, or call 267-210-3274
first_step.basis: The site explains how to register and says the cohorts are free, but it lists no dates for the next cohort.

records.notes: The batch website royalsisterproject.com returned 404. The group's real domain is royalsistersproject.com (plural), which its GoFundMe charity page links. Its GoFundMe page says verified 2025 with no month, so the status is probably_active. The site shows no dated posts, and its 2026 footer is not evidence. The registration form was not submitted.

records.name: 3rd Awakening USA
records.summary: A Christian revival movement that holds worship gatherings and outreach in streets, schools and churches. Members can join outreach teams, take part in prayer efforts, or host an event in their own city.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer on outreach teams, join the prayer effort, or come to a worship gathering. The get-involved page has a volunteer section.

first_step.how: Open the volunteer section of the get-involved page on 3rdawakeningusa.org and ask how to join a local outreach team
first_step.basis: The site invites visitors to join, but names no city, meeting place or schedule, so the local way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site names no city, meeting place, phone number or dated event. Its only date is a 2026 footer, which is not evidence. Philadelphia appears only in the IRS filing address (3500 Teton Rd, 19154), so verify the local tie before going live. The site uses national revival and truth-telling language, but no party, candidate or ballot campaign was named in the pages read. The batch website was typed as https//3rdawakeningusa.org/ and was read as https://3rdawakeningusa.org/. A contact email reported by the page summary was not recorded because it looked inconsistent with the site domain.

records.name: Beyond My Reach
records.notes: The site at beyondmyreach.org returned only a title, 'Beyond My Reach Center', on two fetches, with no description, programs, dates or contacts. Nothing else was found, and no search was spent on it. The IRS filing name is Beyond My Reach Inc. Its filing address is an apartment (3725 Ronnald Dr Apt 2B, 19154), so it is not a public meeting place. Needs a manual check.

records.name: Bury the Children
records.summary: A Philadelphia charity that pays for dignified burials and memorial services for unclaimed children and for unclaimed cremains held by funeral homes. Supporters can help fund plots, caskets and markers.
records.what_you_do: Donate toward plots, caskets and memorial markers by check, mailed to the group's address. Or contact the team through the website to ask about other ways to help.

first_step.how: Mail a check payable to Bury the Children to Christ the King Rectory, 3252 Chesterfield Rd, Philadelphia, PA 19114, or contact the team through the website to ask how to help
first_step.basis: The way in is donating or contacting the team. The site describes no volunteer or sign-up process.

records.notes: Dormant because the newest dated item on the site is a history entry headed 2020 and titled A Growing Need (year only, no month). The 2026 footer is not evidence, and the site describes no current events. Team email addresses are on the page but were not recorded because they belong to individuals. Faith was set to catholic from the page's references to a funeral mass, a parish and a rectory.

records.name: Ekenywa
records.notes: Its public work is in Kenya: community water treatment, kiosk water sales and school hygiene programs. Nothing on the site places it in Philadelphia. The only Philadelphia tie is the IRS filing address (3954 Rowena Dr, 19114).

records.name: Heroes Wish Project
records.summary: Grants wishes, such as trips and special experiences, to veterans and first responders. Supporters can nominate a hero, volunteer, or send a thank-you card to a veteran featured on the site.
records.what_you_do: Nominate a veteran or first responder for a wish, volunteer with the team, or attend one of the group's gatherings. The group asks for donations as well.

first_step.how: Email heroes@heroeswishproject.org to nominate a veteran or first responder, or to ask about volunteering
first_step.basis: The site lists volunteer and event options but gives no sign-up steps and no event dates.

records.notes: The newest dated item is a news link on the group's site. Its date, 2024-09-11, comes only from the article's URL, since the page text shows no date. That is 25 months old, so the status is dormant. The site's upcoming gatherings have no dates, and its 2025 copyright is not evidence. Philadelphia tie: the IRS address (101 Village Ln, 19154) and the Philadelphia veterans home where it sends cards. No tag exists for wish granting, so social-meetups and veterans_posts is the closest fit. Only veterans are recorded as the community, because first responders are not in the community list.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used, cap reached. Fetches: 24 of 60. No bot checks or 403s were met. Dead links are listed under blocked as 404 or DNS failures, not blocks. Verdicts: 13 publish (4 probably_active, 3 dormant, 6 unknown and held back for lack of a summary) and 2 out_of_area (Ekenywa, Nikwia Wodoe). The six unknown records are My Lion S Heart, No More Xcuses Ministries, Beyond My Reach, Living Social Supports, Michael Lutz FOP Lodge 5 Auxiliary and Never Surrender Hope. Two searches were used: My Lion S Heart (no match found) and Royal Sisters Project (the GoFundMe page led to the real domain). Several IRS typed websites were not web addresses (a company name, a bare name, an email address, or a malformed https// link); each is handled in its record. Heroes Wish dormant status rests on a date read from a news link URL, so a reviewer may want to confirm it.
